Andy Burnham's potential UK leadership and salary donation discussed

Andy Burnham, the Member of Parliament for Makerfield, has announced he will donate 15% of his MP's salary to local causes. This comes amid speculation about his potential to succeed Keir Starmer as leader of the Labour Party and Prime Minister. Discussions also involve potential cabinet appointments, such as Ed Miliband as Chancellor, and the broader economic strategy for the party.
